questions.text:
Consider the following page reference string.
1 2 3 4 2 1 5 6 2 1 2 3 7 6 3 2 1 2 3 6
What are the minimum number of frames required to get a single page fault for the above sequence assuming LRU replacement strategy?
questions.solution:
There are 7 distinct pages (1-7), so at least 7 compulsory faults always happen. We want each page to fault only once.

- With 6 frames (LRU), the only eviction happens when 7 arrives, and it evicts page 4, which is never used again. No page faults twice.
- With 5 frames, page 6 evicts page 3, and page 3 is needed again later [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] a second fault for page 3.

Answer: 6

questions.text: Which of the following algorithms defines time quantum?
questions.solution:
Round robin gives each process a fixed time quantum (time slice) before preempting it.

Answer: round robin scheduling algorithm

questions.text: The operating system and the other processes are protected from being modified by an already running process because
questions.solution:
Memory protection hardware compares every address generated by the CPU with the process's relocation (base) and limit registers. An address outside its own range causes a trap, so a process cannot touch the OS or other processes.

Answer: every address generated by the CPU is checked against the relocation and limit parameters
